public.fn_resolve_accounting_routing_sco.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_resolve_accounting_routing_scope(p_scope_kind text, p_scope_id uuid, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(union_id uuid, standalone_club_id uuid, club_ids uuid[], scope_key text, lock_key text, routing_context text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.fn_caller_is_engine() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF p_scope_kind IS NULL OR p_scope_kind NOT IN('union','club') OR p_scope_id IS NULL
  OR (p_scope_kind='union' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.unions u WHERE u.id=p_scope_id))
  OR (p_scope_kind='club' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id=p_scope_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_accounting_routing_scope' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 union_id:=CASE WHEN p_scope_kind='union' THEN p_scope_id END;
 standalone_club_id:=CASE WHEN p_scope_kind='club' THEN p_scope_id END;
 -- Preserve union keys and the established coordinator lock exactly. Club keys
 -- have an explicit prefix so even identical UUID values can never collide.
 scope_key:=CASE WHEN p_scope_kind='union' THEN p_scope_id::text ELSE 'club:'||p_scope_id::text END;
 lock_key:=CASE WHEN p_scope_kind='union' THEN 'union-accounting:' ELSE 'club-accounting:' END||p_scope_id::text||':'||extract(epoch FROM p_period_start)::text||':'||extract(epoch FROM p_period_end)::text;
 routing_context:=scope_key||':'||p_period_start::text||':'||p_period_end::text;
 -- Acquire before reading source-club membership: a waiting close must see all
 -- earning sources committed by the previous lock holder. Accrual shares this key.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(lock_key,0));
 IF p_scope_kind='union' THEN
  club_ids:=ARRAY(WITH RECURSIVE
cash_clubs(club_id) AS (
 (SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s WHERE s.club_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.club_id FROM cash_clubs c CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 (SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s WHERE s.club_id>c.club_id ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1)n
),
fee_clubs(club_id) AS (
 (SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources s WHERE s.club_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT n.club_id FROM fee_clubs c CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 (SELECT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources s WHERE s.club_id>c.club_id ORDER BY s.club_id LIMIT 1)n
),
accepted_cash AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT k.club_id FROM cash_clubs k CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 (SELECT true FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources rs WHERE rs.source_type='cash_rake_accrual'
 AND rs.club_id=k.club_id AND rs.coordinator_union_id=p_scope_id
 AND rs.earned_at>=p_period_start AND rs.earned_at<p_period_end LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0)w
 UNION ALL SELECT NULL::uuid WHERE EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources rs
 WHERE rs.source_type='cash_rake_accrual' AND rs.club_id IS NULL AND rs.coordinator_union_id=p_scope_id
 AND rs.earned_at>=p_period_start AND rs.earned_at<p_period_end)
),
fee_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k.club_id FROM fee_clubs k WHERE NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT FROM accepted_cash c WHERE c.club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.club_id)),
accepted_fee AS (
 SELECT k.club_id FROM fee_candidates k CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT true FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources fee CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT true FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources rs WHERE rs.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual'
 AND rs.source_id=fee.id AND rs.club_id=k.club_id AND rs.coordinator_union_id=p_scope_id
 AND rs.earned_at>=p_period_start AND rs.earned_at<p_period_end LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0)witness
 WHERE fee.club_id=k.club_id AND fee.coordinator_union_id=p_scope_id
 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0)w
 UNION ALL SELECT NULL::uuid WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM accepted_cash c WHERE c.club_id IS NULL)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources rs
 WHERE rs.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual' AND rs.club_id IS NULL AND rs.coordinator_union_id=p_scope_id
 AND rs.earned_at>=p_period_start AND rs.earned_at<p_period_end)
)
SELECT uc.club_id FROM public.union_clubs uc WHERE uc.union_id=p_scope_id
 AND((isfinite(p_period_start) AND isfinite(p_period_end) AND p_period_end>p_period_start) IS NOT TRUE OR uc.joined_at IS NULL OR uc.joined_at<p_period_end)
 UNION SELECT ac.club_id FROM accepted_cash ac UNION SELECT af.club_id FROM accepted_fee af ORDER BY club_id);
 ELSE club_ids:=ARRAY[p_scope_id];END IF;
 RETURN NEXT;
END $function$

public.fn_settle_accounting_rakeback_pai.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_settle_accounting_rakeback_pairs(p_scope_kind text, p_scope_id uuid, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(club_id uuid, player_id uuid, n bigint, nn bigint, d1 numeric, d2 numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 -- Every window of the week, read after it closed and within 12 hours, none
 -- failed - or no rows at all.
 WITH w AS (SELECT p.value FROM public.fn_accounting_close_windows(p_period_start,p_period_end) x
   JOIN public.accounting_close_partials p ON p.kind='round3_'||p_scope_kind||'_window' AND p.union_id=p_scope_id
    AND p.period_start=p_period_start AND p.period_end=p_period_end AND p.window_start=x.window_start AND p.window_end=x.window_end
    AND p.computed_at>=p_period_end AND p.computed_at>clock_timestamp()-public.fn_accounting_close_proof_lifetime()),
 ok AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE w.value->>'read_failed'='false')=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fn_accounting_close_windows(p_period_start,p_period_end))
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fn_accounting_close_windows(p_period_start,p_period_end))>0 AS ok)
 SELECT (e->>0)::uuid,(e->>1)::uuid,sum((e->>2)::bigint)::bigint,sum((e->>3)::bigint)::bigint,sum((e->>4)::numeric),sum((e->>5)::numeric)
  FROM w CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(w.value->'pairs') e WHERE (SELECT ok FROM ok)
  GROUP BY (e->>0)::uuid,(e->>1)::uuid
$function$

public.fn_settle_accounting_rakeback_pla.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_settle_accounting_rakeback_plan_get(p_scope_kind text, p_scope_id uuid, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone, p_club_ids uuid[], p_union_id uuid, p_standalone_club_id uuid, p_legacy boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 -- The kept round-3 read of this book's week: only inside a chunked close
 -- attempt, for the same scope (union, standalone club, clubs) and the same
 -- (non-legacy) source typing, with every window and the certificates' read
 -- made after the week closed and within 12 hours. A period's any-bad flag is
 -- its element-only tests or its allocations' md5 sums disagreeing with its
 -- (club, player)'s sources.
 WITH p AS (SELECT p.value FROM public.accounting_close_partials p
  WHERE COALESCE(current_setting('app.weekly_accounting_chunked',true),'')='on'
   AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.weekly_accounting_scope_deadline',true),'') IS NOT NULL
   AND p.kind='round3_'||p_scope_kind||'_plan' AND p.union_id=p_scope_id AND p.period_start=p_period_start AND p.period_end=p_period_end
   AND p.window_start=p_period_start AND p.window_end=p_period_end
   AND p.computed_at>=p_period_end AND p.computed_at>clock_timestamp()-public.fn_accounting_close_proof_lifetime()
   AND p.value->>'failed'='false' AND p_legacy IS FALSE AND p.value->>'legacy'='false'
   AND p.value->'club_ids'=to_jsonb(p_club_ids)
   AND (p.value->>'union_id')::uuid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_union_id
   AND (p.value->>'standalone_club_id')::uuid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_standalone_club_id),
 q AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM public.fn_settle_accounting_rakeback_pairs(p_scope_kind,p_scope_id,p_period_start,p_period_end) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p))
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'pairs',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(q.club_id,q.player_id)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM q),
   'counts',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(q.club_id,q.player_id,q.n)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM q),
   'nonhouse',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(q.club_id,q.player_id)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM q WHERE q.nn>0),
   'alloc',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e->0,e->1,e->2,e->3,e->4,e->5,e->6,e->7,
      COALESCE((e->>8)::boolean,true) OR q2.d1 IS DISTINCT FROM (e->>9)::numeric OR q2.d2 IS DISTINCT FROM (e->>10)::numeric)),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.value->'alloc') e
     LEFT JOIN q q2 ON q2.club_id=(e->>2)::uuid AND q2.player_id=(e->>3)::uuid))
 FROM p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM q)
$function$

public.fn_standalone_foreign_certificate.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_standalone_foreign_certificate_periods(p_scope_kind text, p_club uuid, p_from_date date, p_to_date date, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(period_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH src AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.source_type,s.source_id,s.club_id,s.player_id,s.coordinator_union_id,s.earned_at,s.rake_credit,s.rake_record_id
  FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s
  WHERE p_scope_kind='club' AND p_club IS NOT NULL AND s.club_id=p_club AND s.earned_at>=p_period_start AND s.earned_at<p_period_end),
cnt AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT src.player_id,src.coordinator_union_id,count(*) n FROM src GROUP BY 1,2),
own AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT src.player_id FROM src WHERE src.coordinator_union_id IS NULL),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT rp.user_id,foreign_cert.* FROM public.rakeback_periods rp
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT fc.* FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations fc
     WHERE fc.period_id=rp.id ORDER BY fc.id DESC LIMIT 1)foreign_cert
  WHERE p_scope_kind='club' AND p_club IS NOT NULL AND rp.club_id=p_club
   AND rp.period_start=p_from_date AND rp.period_end=p_to_date
   AND foreign_cert.accounting_version=2 AND foreign_cert.coordinator_union_id IS NOT NULL
   AND foreign_cert.club_id=rp.club_id AND foreign_cert.player_id=rp.user_id
   AND foreign_cert.period_start=rp.period_start AND foreign_cert.period_end=rp.period_end
   AND foreign_cert.rake_generated=rp.rake_generated AND foreign_cert.rake_generated=rp.total_rake_paid
   AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount=rp.rakeback_amount AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount=rp.rakeback_earned
   AND foreign_cert.display_rate=rp.rakeback_rate AND foreign_cert.rake_generated>=0
   AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount>=0 AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount=round(foreign_cert.rakeback_amount,2)
   AND foreign_cert.rake_generated::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND foreign_cert.payer_kind IN('agent','club','split')
   AND (foreign_cert.payer_kind='agent')=(foreign_cert.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL)
   AND foreign_cert.payer_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM rp.user_id
   AND foreign_cert.display_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND foreign_cert.display_rate=round(foreign_cert.display_rate,4)
   AND foreign_cert.rakeback_amount<=foreign_cert.rake_generated
   AND jsonb_typeof(foreign_cert.source_allocations)='array'
   AND foreign_cert.source_allocations<>'[]'::jsonb
   AND foreign_cert.source_fingerprint=md5(jsonb_build_object('allocations',foreign_cert.source_allocations,
     'rake',foreign_cert.rake_generated,'amount',foreign_cert.rakeback_amount,'rate',foreign_cert.display_rate)::text)),
allocation_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT foreign_cert.period_id,foreign_cert.club_id,foreign_cert.player_id,
    foreign_cert.coordinator_union_id,foreign_cert.payer_kind,foreign_cert.payer_user_id,
    a.value AS allocation
  FROM cand foreign_cert
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(foreign_cert.source_allocations) a(value)),
bad AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT foreign_cert.period_id FROM allocation_rows foreign_cert
  LEFT JOIN src fs ON fs.source_type=(foreign_cert.allocation)->>'source_type' AND fs.source_id=((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'source_id')::uuid
  WHERE fs.source_id IS NULL OR fs.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM foreign_cert.club_id
   OR fs.player_id IS DISTINCT FROM foreign_cert.player_id
   OR fs.coordinator_union_id IS DISTINCT FROM foreign_cert.coordinator_union_id
   OR fs.earned_at<p_period_start OR fs.earned_at>=p_period_end
   OR fs.rake_credit IS DISTINCT FROM((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'rake_credit')::numeric
   OR fs.rake_record_id IS DISTINCT FROM((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'rake_record_id')::uuid
   OR (foreign_cert.allocation)->>'source_type' NOT IN('cash_rake_accrual','tournament_fee_accrual')
   OR ((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'rate')::numeric IS NULL OR ((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'rate')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1
   OR ((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'rate')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR (foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_kind' IS NULL OR (foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_kind' NOT IN('agent','club')
   OR NULLIF((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid=foreign_cert.player_id
   OR ((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_kind'='agent') IS DISTINCT FROM(NULLIF((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_user_id','') IS NOT NULL)
   OR (foreign_cert.payer_kind<>'split' AND((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM foreign_cert.payer_kind
     OR NULLIF((foreign_cert.allocation)->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM foreign_cert.payer_user_id)))
SELECT foreign_cert.period_id FROM cand foreign_cert
WHERE (SELECT count(*)=count(DISTINCT ROW(a->>'source_type',a->>'source_id'))
   AND sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric)=foreign_cert.rake_generated
   AND round(sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric),2)=foreign_cert.rakeback_amount
   AND CASE WHEN foreign_cert.rake_generated>0 THEN round(sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric)/foreign_cert.rake_generated,4) ELSE 0 END=foreign_cert.display_rate
   AND count(*)=COALESCE((SELECT c.n FROM cnt c WHERE c.player_id=foreign_cert.player_id AND c.coordinator_union_id=foreign_cert.coordinator_union_id),0)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(foreign_cert.source_allocations) a)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bad b WHERE b.period_id=foreign_cert.period_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM own o WHERE o.player_id=foreign_cert.user_id)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_owner_membership_is_kept()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    -- Only a change that ends or moves an ACTIVE membership matters; a role
    -- change, a balance or a reactivation is not a removal.
    IF NOT (OLD.membership_lifecycle_status = 'active'
            AND COALESCE(OLD.status, 'active') IN ('active', 'approved')
            AND COALESCE(OLD.is_active, true)) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.club_id = OLD.club_id AND NEW.user_id = OLD.user_id
       AND NEW.membership_lifecycle_status = 'active'
       AND COALESCE(NEW.status, 'active') IN ('active', 'approved')
       AND COALESCE(NEW.is_active, true) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id = OLD.club_id)
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = OLD.user_id) THEN
    -- The club or the person itself is being deleted (ON DELETE CASCADE).
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc
               JOIN public.unions u ON u.id = uc.union_id
              WHERE uc.club_id = OLD.club_id
                AND u.owner_id = OLD.user_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNION_OWNER_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED: The Union Owner Must Stay A Member Of Every Club In The Union'
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation',
            HINT = 'Take the club out of the union, or transfer the union, before this membership can end.';
  END IF;
  RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
END;
$function$

    'that log to chip_ledger. Admin override: '
    'SELECT set_config(''app.bypass_wallet_guard'', ''on'', true);',
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME

DECLARE

BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'wallet_transactions' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT x.d FROM (
          SELECT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
              OR o.type IS DISTINCT FROM n.type

              OR o.table_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.table_id
              OR o.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.related_entity_id
              OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
          UNION
          SELECT (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
        ) x
        ORDER BY x.d
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    ELSE
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
          FROM old_rows o ORDER BY 1
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'rake_records' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT x.d FROM (
          SELECT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.rake_amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.rake_amount
              OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
              OR o.tournament_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.tournament_id
              OR o.is_tournament IS DISTINCT FROM n.is_tournament
              OR o.metadata IS DISTINCT FROM n.metadata
              OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
          UNION
          SELECT (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
        ) x
        ORDER BY x.d

          FROM old_rows o ORDER BY 1
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.assert_own_agent_scope_interpreted(p_kind text, p_scope uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- The original paid receipt always decides its own replay, including books
 -- with a later approved adjustment. This guard never upgrades a paid source.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_routed_settlement_runs r WHERE r.scope_kind=p_kind AND r.scope_id=p_scope AND r.period_start=p_from AND r.period_end=p_to AND r.round_no=p_round)THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_own_agent_preparation_versions v WHERE v.scope_kind=p_kind AND v.scope_id=p_scope AND v.period_start=p_from AND v.period_end=p_to AND v.version='own-agent-v1'AND v.owner_hashes=jsonb_build_object('producer',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_accounting_earning_contract(uuid,uuid,numeric,uuid,timestamptz)'::regprocedure)),'calculator',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_calculate_cash_rakeback_periods(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure)),'split_check',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_rakeback_split_check(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure)),'split_write',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_rakeback_split_write(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure))))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_source_interpretation_required_before_payment' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 -- Historical entitlement survives suspension. Frozen, missing or ambiguous
 -- current own-agent destinations cannot accept a new transfer. Deleted
 -- profiles retain the original documented discharge transaction below.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s WHERE s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to AND((p_kind='union'AND s.coordinator_union_id=p_scope)OR(p_kind='club'AND s.club_id=p_scope AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL))AND coalesce(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,role}','')IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')AND s.contract#>>'{tiers,0,user_id}'IS DISTINCT FROM s.player_id::text
 AND NOT(coalesce((s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,player_rakeback_pct}')::numeric=.70,false)AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id=s.club_id AND c.owner_id=NULLIF(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,agent_id}','')::uuid))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_own_agent_source_reviews a WHERE a.source_type=s.source_type AND a.source_id=s.source_id AND a.version='own-agent-v1'AND a.effective_contract_md5=md5(s.contract::text)))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_source_interpretation_pending' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s LEFT JOIN public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources f ON f.id=CASE WHEN s.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual'THEN s.source_id END
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*)n,min(a.status)status,min(a.role)role FROM public.agents a WHERE a.club_id=s.club_id AND a.user_id=s.player_id)g
 WHERE s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to AND((p_kind='union'AND s.coordinator_union_id=p_scope)OR(p_kind='club'AND s.club_id=p_scope AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL))AND s.rake_credit>0
 AND coalesce(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,role}','')IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')
 AND(s.contract#>>'{tiers,0,user_id}'=s.player_id::text OR smarter_private.own_agent_destination_contract(s.contract,s.club_id,s.player_id,CASE WHEN s.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual'THEN public.fn_accounting_tournament_source_terms_at(f.tournament_id,f.charged_at,f.contract)ELSE s.earned_at END)IS NOT NULL)
 AND(g.n<>1 OR coalesce(g.role,'')NOT IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')OR(coalesce(g.status,'')NOT IN('active','suspended')AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=s.player_id AND p.status='deleted'))))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_current_destination_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;

END $function$

smarter_private.deleted_wallet_published.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.deleted_wallet_published_rakeback_reserve(p_club uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 r public.rakeback_periods%ROWTYPE;
 c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
 reserved numeric:=0;
 locked_period_ids uuid[];
BEGIN
 IF p_club IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_identity_required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;
 -- Publishers lock an existing period FOR UPDATE before adding its certificate.
 -- NOWAIT is essential: caller may already own the member row, while the
 -- ordinary stage owns period rows before member rows. Never wait in reverse.
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(locked.id ORDER BY locked.id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO locked_period_ids
 FROM (SELECT rp.id FROM public.rakeback_periods rp
       WHERE rp.club_id=p_club AND rp.status='pending'
       ORDER BY rp.id FOR SHARE NOWAIT) locked;
 -- Visit ONLY the locked admission cohort, not a second fresh pending scan.
 FOR r IN SELECT rp.* FROM public.rakeback_periods rp
          WHERE rp.id=ANY(locked_period_ids) ORDER BY rp.id
 LOOP
  -- Select latest FIRST. An invalid latest certificate must not expose funds
  -- by falling back to an older certificate or disappearing from a filtered sum.
  SELECT pc.* INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations pc
  WHERE pc.period_id=r.id ORDER BY pc.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_latest_certificate_required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  IF r.id IS NULL OR r.club_id IS NULL OR r.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_club
   OR r.user_id IS NULL OR r.period_start IS NULL OR r.period_end IS NULL
   OR NOT isfinite(r.period_start) OR NOT isfinite(r.period_end)
   OR r.period_start>r.period_end OR extract(isodow FROM r.period_start)<>1 OR r.period_end<>r.period_start+6
   OR r.rake_generated IS NULL OR r.total_rake_paid IS NULL
   OR r.rakeback_amount IS NULL OR r.rakeback_earned IS NULL OR r.rakeback_rate IS NULL
   OR c.id IS NULL OR c.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.id
   OR c.accounting_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2
   OR c.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id OR c.player_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.user_id
   OR c.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_start OR c.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_end
   OR c.rake_generated IS NULL OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.rake_generated
   OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.total_rake_paid
   OR c.rake_generated<0 OR c.rake_generated::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.rakeback_amount IS NULL OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_amount
   OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_earned
   OR c.rakeback_amount<0 OR c.rakeback_amount>c.rake_generated OR c.rakeback_amount<>round(c.rakeback_amount,2)
   OR c.rakeback_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.display_rate IS NULL OR c.display_rate IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_rate
   OR c.display_rate<0 OR c.display_rate>1 OR c.display_rate<>round(c.display_rate,4)
   OR c.display_rate::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.payer_kind IS NULL OR c.payer_kind NOT IN ('agent','club','split')
   OR (c.payer_kind='agent') IS DISTINCT FROM (c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR c.payer_user_id=r.user_id
   OR c.source_fingerprint IS NULL OR c.source_fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'
  THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_certificate_identity_invalid' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  -- The owning R3 stage refuses any existing payout for a pending period.
  -- A pending row plus a paid receipt must never be mistaken for free money.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts pp WHERE pp.rakeback_period_id=r.id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_pending_payout_conflict' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  IF c.payer_kind='split' THEN
   -- Same immutable certificate producer; retain all child liabilities before
   -- any deleted account's free net is returned by the existing R2/R3 owner.
   reserved:=reserved+COALESCE((SELECT sum(g.owed) FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g WHERE g.payer_kind='agent' AND g.payer_user=p_user),0);
  ELSIF c.payer_kind='agent' AND c.payer_user_id=p_user THEN
   reserved:=reserved+c.rakeback_amount;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN reserved;
END;
$function$

 l public.chip_ledger%ROWTYPE;r public.chip_ledger%ROWTYPE;tx public.chip_transactions%ROWTYPE;op public.cashier_rpc_operation_intents%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO a FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_allocations WHERE obligation_role=p_role AND obligation_id=p_obligation;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO i FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_instructions WHERE id=a.instruction_id;
 SELECT * INTO l FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE id=a.original_ledger_id;
 SELECT * INTO tx FROM public.chip_transactions WHERE id=a.original_transaction_id;
 SELECT * INTO op FROM public.cashier_rpc_operation_intents WHERE operation_id=a.original_operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE id=a.reimbursement_ledger_id;
 IF i.id IS NULL OR l.id IS NULL OR tx.id IS NULL OR op.operation_id IS NULL OR r.id IS NULL
 OR a.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.club_id OR a.beneficiary_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.beneficiary_id OR a.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM i.period_start OR a.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM i.period_end
 OR NOT(a.obligation_role=ANY(i.roles)) OR a.original_ledger_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.original_ledger_id
 OR a.original_evidence->'instruction'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(i)OR a.original_evidence->'ledger'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(l)
 OR a.original_evidence->'transaction'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(tx)OR a.original_evidence->'cashier_operation'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(op)
 OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent_send'OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_credit
 OR tx.is_reversed IS DISTINCT FROM false OR tx.clawed_back IS DISTINCT FROM false OR(tx.metadata->>'claimed_back')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR(SELECT sum(amount)FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_allocations WHERE original_ledger_id=l.id)>l.amount
 OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'OR r.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'treasury_transfer'OR r.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.club_id
 OR r.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'club_treasury'OR r.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.club_id OR r.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent_wallet'OR r.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_payer_id
 OR r.amount IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount OR r.pre_from_balance-r.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount OR r.post_to_balance-r.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount
 OR r.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'existing-rakeback-reimbursement:v1:'||a.obligation_role||':'||a.obligation_id::text
 OR r.metadata->>'payment_method'IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner_confirmed_existing_transfer'
 OR(r.metadata->>'period_start')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.period_start OR(r.metadata->>'period_end')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.period_end
 OR r.metadata->>'existing_transfer_allocation_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.id::text OR r.metadata->>'original_ledger_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_ledger_id::text
 OR r.metadata->>'beneficiary_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.beneficiary_id::text OR r.metadata->>'obligation_role'IS DISTINCT FROM a.obligation_role
 OR r.metadata->>'actual_prior_destination'IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'OR r.metadata->>'source_fingerprint'IS DISTINCT FROM a.source_fingerprint
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices d WHERE d.source_ledger_id=r.id AND d.status='paid'AND d.chips_transferred AND d.message_sent AND d.gross_amount=a.amount AND d.net_amount=a.amount AND d.deductions=0)<>1
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF a.obligation_role='player' THEN
  RETURN EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_periods rp JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations c ON c.period_id=rp.id
   JOIN public.rakeback_period_payouts pp ON pp.id=a.payout_id AND pp.rakeback_period_id=rp.id
   WHERE rp.id=a.obligation_id AND rp.status='paid'AND rp.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND rp.user_id=a.beneficiary_id AND rp.club_id=a.club_id AND rp.rakeback_amount=a.amount
   AND c.id=a.certificate_id AND c.id=(SELECT max(z.id)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations z WHERE z.period_id=rp.id)
   AND c.source_fingerprint=a.source_fingerprint AND c.rakeback_amount=a.amount AND c.player_id=a.beneficiary_id AND c.club_id=a.club_id
   AND pp.status='paid'AND pp.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND pp.user_id=a.beneficiary_id AND pp.club_id=a.club_id AND pp.payout_amount=a.amount AND pp.wallet_transaction_id IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.wallet_transactions w WHERE w.related_entity_id=a.payout_id AND w.category='rakeback')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_payers(p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(payer_kind text, payer_user uuid, payer_entity uuid, owed numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;plan jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF c.payer_kind<>'split' THEN
  IF c.payer_kind NOT IN('agent','club') OR(c.payer_kind='agent')IS DISTINCT FROM(c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_certificate_payer_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT c.payer_kind,c.payer_user_id,COALESCE(c.payer_user_id,c.club_id),c.rakeback_amount;RETURN;
 END IF;
 plan:=smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(c.source_allocations,c.rakeback_amount);
 IF jsonb_array_length(plan)<2 OR c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL
  OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g WHERE g.calculation_id=c.id)<>jsonb_array_length(plan)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan)p LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g
   ON g.calculation_id=c.id AND g.payer_kind=p->>'payer_kind' AND g.payer_entity_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(p->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid,c.club_id)
   WHERE g.calculation_id IS NULL OR g.payer_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(p->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid
    OR g.amount IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'amount')::numeric OR g.unrounded IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'unrounded')::numeric
    OR g.rake IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'rake')::numeric OR g.source_count IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'source_count')::bigint
    OR g.source_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint OR g.payer_user_id=c.player_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'split_rakeback_payer_contracts_disagree' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT g.payer_kind,g.payer_user_id,g.payer_entity_id,g.amount FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g
  WHERE g.calculation_id=c.id ORDER BY g.payer_kind,g.payer_entity_id;
END $function$

smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(p_al.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(p_allocations jsonb, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;expected numeric;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_allocations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_allocations)=0
 OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount<0 OR p_amount<>round(p_amount,2) OR p_amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_plan_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a
  WHERE a->>'payer_kind' IS NULL OR a->>'payer_kind' NOT IN('club','agent')
   OR (a->>'payer_kind'='agent') IS DISTINCT FROM(NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','') IS NOT NULL)
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric IS NULL OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric<0
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric<>round((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric,2)
   OR (a->>'rate')::numeric IS NULL OR (a->>'rate')::numeric<0 OR (a->>'rate')::numeric>1
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR (a->>'rate')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_allocation_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT round(sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric),2) INTO expected
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a;
 IF expected IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_total_disagrees' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH g AS(
  SELECT a->>'payer_kind' kind,NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid payer,
   sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric) rake,sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric) unrounded,count(*) n
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a GROUP BY a->>'payer_kind',NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid
 ), cents AS(
  SELECT g.*,floor(unrounded*100) whole,
   row_number() OVER(ORDER BY unrounded*100-floor(unrounded*100) DESC,kind,payer NULLS FIRST) remainder_rank,
   p_amount*100-sum(floor(unrounded*100)) OVER() extra FROM g
 )SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('payer_kind',kind,'payer_user_id',payer,'rake',rake,
   'unrounded',unrounded,'source_count',n,'amount',(whole+CASE WHEN remainder_rank<=extra THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/100)
   ORDER BY kind,payer NULLS FIRST) INTO result FROM cents;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_wallet_payout_complete(p_payout uuid, p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp public.rakeback_period_payouts%ROWTYPE;c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT*INTO pp FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE id=p_payout;
 SELECT*INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF pp.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR pp.status IS DISTINCT FROM'paid'OR pp.rakeback_period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR pp.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR pp.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR pp.payout_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_periods r WHERE r.id=c.period_id AND r.status='paid')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_contracts w WHERE w.calculation_id=c.id AND w.destination_kind='agent_wallet')THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t WHERE t.payout_id=pp.id)<>(SELECT count(*)FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g WHERE g.owed>0)THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g
 LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t ON t.payout_id=pp.id AND t.payer_kind=g.payer_kind AND t.payer_entity_id=g.payer_entity AND t.destination_kind=g.destination_kind
 LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=t.ledger_id LEFT JOIN public.wallet_transactions w ON w.id=t.wallet_transaction_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT CASE WHEN g.payer_kind='club'OR g.payer_user IS NULL OR(l.from_type='club_treasury'AND l.metadata->>'owner_share_payer'=g.payer_user::text)THEN'club_treasury'ELSE'agent_wallet'END kind)funded
 WHERE g.owed>0 AND(t.payout_id IS NULL OR t.calculation_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.id OR t.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR t.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR l.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind OR l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN funded.kind='club_treasury'THEN c.club_id ELSE g.payer_user END
 OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM'posted'
 OR l.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM'round3-period:own-agent-v1:'||c.period_id||':payer:'||g.payer_kind||':'||g.payer_entity||':destination:'||g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata?'certificate_kind'OR l.metadata->>'routing_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'3'
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN c.coordinator_union_id IS NULL THEN'club'ELSE'union'END
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_id'IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(c.coordinator_union_id,c.club_id)::text
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_start')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM(c.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_end')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM((c.period_end+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_transaction_id'IS DISTINCT FROM t.wallet_transaction_id::text
 OR l.metadata->>'paid_from'IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind
 OR l.metadata->>'payee_role_at_transfer'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'agent'ELSE'player'END
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_destination_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'own-agent-v1'OR l.metadata->>'destination_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata->>'certificate_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text OR l.metadata->>'payout_id'IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id::text OR l.metadata->>'period_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id::text OR l.metadata->>'source_fingerprint'IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
 OR l.pre_from_balance-l.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.post_to_balance-l.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR w.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR w.type IS DISTINCT FROM'credit'OR w.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR w.wallet_type IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'BUSINESS'ELSE'PLAYER'END
 OR w.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR w.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id OR w.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM l.post_to_balance
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices i WHERE i.source_ledger_id=l.id AND i.status='paid'AND i.chips_transferred AND i.message_sent AND i.net_amount=g.owed AND i.gross_amount=g.owed AND i.deductions=0)<>1));
EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation OR data_exception OR no_data_found THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

smarter_private.split_rakeback_payout_co.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.split_rakeback_payout_complete(p_payout uuid, p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp public.rakeback_period_payouts%ROWTYPE;c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO pp FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE id=p_payout;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF pp.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR c.payer_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'split' OR pp.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'paid'
  OR pp.rakeback_period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR pp.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id
  OR pp.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR pp.payout_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rakeback_periods r WHERE r.id=c.period_id AND r.status='paid')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_transfers t WHERE t.payout_id=pp.id)
   <>(SELECT count(*)FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g WHERE g.owed>0)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g
 LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_payer_transfers t ON t.payout_id=pp.id AND t.payer_kind=g.payer_kind AND t.payer_entity_id=g.payer_entity
 LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=t.ledger_id
 LEFT JOIN public.wallet_transactions w ON w.id=t.wallet_transaction_id
 WHERE g.owed>0 AND(t.payout_id IS NULL OR t.calculation_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.id OR t.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id
  OR t.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id
  OR NOT COALESCE(CASE WHEN g.payer_kind='club' THEN l.from_type='club_treasury' AND l.from_entity_id=g.payer_entity
    WHEN l.from_type IN('player_wallet','agent_wallet') THEN l.from_entity_id=g.payer_entity
    ELSE l.from_type='club_treasury' AND l.from_entity_id=c.club_id AND l.metadata->>'owner_share_payer'=g.payer_entity::text END,false)
  OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'rakeback' OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
  OR l.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'round3-period:v3:'||c.period_id::text||':payer:'||g.payer_kind||':'||g.payer_entity::text
  OR l.metadata->>'certificate_id' IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text OR l.metadata->>'payout_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id::text
  OR l.metadata->>'period_id' IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id::text OR l.metadata->>'source_fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
  OR l.pre_from_balance-l.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.post_to_balance-l.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
  OR w.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR w.type IS DISTINCT FROM 'credit' OR w.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
  OR w.wallet_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'PLAYER' OR w.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'rakeback'
  OR w.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id OR w.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM l.post_to_balance
  OR(g.payer_kind='agent' AND l.from_type='player_wallet' AND(SELECT count(*)FROM public.wallet_transactions wd WHERE wd.related_entity_id=pp.id
    AND wd.user_id=g.payer_user AND wd.wallet_type='PLAYER' AND wd.type='debit' AND wd.category='rakeback'
    AND wd.amount=g.owed AND wd.balance_after=l.post_from_balance)<>1)
  OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices i WHERE i.source_ledger_id=l.id AND i.status='paid' AND i.chips_transferred
    AND i.message_sent AND i.gross_amount=g.owed AND i.net_amount=g.owed AND i.deductions=0)<>1));
EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation OR data_exception OR no_data_found THEN
 RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round(p_kind text, p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_owned_transactions c
  JOIN public.weekly_accounting_payout_pauses r ON r.run_id=c.run_id
  WHERE c.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND c.transaction_id=txid_current()
   AND c.scope_kind=p_kind AND c.scope_id=p_id AND c.period_start=p_from AND c.period_end=p_to AND c.round_no=p_round
   AND r.phase='paying' AND r.acknowledged_at>=r.announced_at AND r.acknowledged_at<r.money_deadline_at
   AND smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()>=r.money_starts_at
   AND smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()<r.money_deadline_at
   AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.scope_plan) j WHERE j->>'kind'=p_kind AND (j->>'id')::uuid=p_id
    AND (j->>'period_start')::timestamptz=p_from AND (j->>'period_end')::timestamptz=p_to))
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_require_ro.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_require_round(p_kind text, p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- This change never reinterprets an old paid contract or the incident week.
 IF p_to<(SELECT cutover_period_end FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_phase_configuration WHERE singleton) THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF NOT smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round(p_kind,p_id,p_from,p_to,p_round) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_payout_original_owned_phase_required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 PERFORM public.fn_weekly_accounting_deadline_check();
END $function$
